title: Wire OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR and OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN and prove the plugin Quest hook fires
description: opum-workflow plugin flush-state.sh (PreCompact/SessionEnd) only writes its tracker note when both OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR and OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN are set, and it swallows failure so a hook never wedges a session -- so an unset pair leaves the cursor appearing to work while nothing reaches the tracker. Neither is set in this repo today. Add an env block to committed .claude/settings.json naming this session and the accountable human (git author identity, already public on every commit here), then prove it live rather than trusting the config: run a headless claude -p session with exactly one LCLI task In Progress and confirm quest task view shows a note beginning Session session-end at ...

acceptanceCriteria.text: A headless claude -p run with exactly one LCLI task In Progress produces a quest task view note beginning Session session-end at ...
The proof transcript or command output is recorded in the task implementation notes, not just asserted

implementationNotes: PROVEN 2026-09-05, not in the live lore-cli tracker (Quest forbids In Progress -> To Do, so isolating exactly one live In-Progress task without permanently completing real work was impossible -- confirmed by a rejected quest task edit --status "To Do" attempt on LCLI-360/LCLI-439). Instead proved the identical mechanism in a disposable scratch git+Quest workspace carrying this repo's real settings values: git init + quest init a scratch repo, created one task (PROOF-1), set it In Progress (verified exactly one In Progress task), wrote .claude/settings.json with env.OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR=lore-cli-session and env.OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN=jeremy.newhouse@salientdata.ai (the same values landed in this repo committed settings.json), then ran claude -p "Reply with exactly the word: ack" --tools "" (headless, no tools, so the SessionEnd hook is the only thing that could write anything). Result: quest task view PROOF-1 shows implementationNotes containing exactly "Session session-end at 2026-09-05T05:04:27Z. Branch main, 2 uncommitted file(s). Written by the opum-workflow session-end hook, not by the model." -- the harness read the env block from settings.json, the plugin SessionEnd hook fired, and flush-state.sh's quest task edit --add-note landed. Scratch workspace deleted after capturing this evidence.

Corrected 2026-09-05 per opum-agent ruling: OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN changed from the email jeremy.newhouse@salientdata.ai to the handle jdnewhouse, matching opum-agent and opum-doc's convention (one id per human, fleet-wide, public repo). Amended before #566 merged.
